text:
Maria: Starting rollout of signed BMC image v2.3.1-signed to eu-west canary (10 hosts) at 21:03 UTC. small smoke passed but saw 3 PXE/provision timeouts on rack eu1-gpu-07. pausing? :thinking:
OncallBot: deploy-bot started job FW-ROLL-2105 -> canary group eu-west (10 hosts).
Akshay: can you paste the bmc and serial logs from the failing hosts? want to check if secure-boot flag toggled or if signature verify failed.
Maria: logs pasted below for host eu1-gpu-07-03:
```
[2026-03-18T21:04:12Z] bmc: firmware: image install ok
[2026-03-18T21:04:18Z] bmc: secureboot: verify sig chunk1 ok
[2026-03-18T21:04:18Z] bmc: secureboot: verify sig chunk2 FAILED (0x27)
[2026-03-18T21:04:19Z] bmc: nvram write error: crc mismatch
[2026-03-18T21:04:20Z] ipmi: pxe: tftp timeout
```
Maria: also seeing UEFI var sync warnings in the system log. looks like the BMC applied the image but NVRAM update failed so the host fell back to PXE.
Lee: nvram CRC mismatch = known on that HW revision (A2) if the BMC write window overlaps ACPI reinit. we saw similar in lab when host was under power stress. not a signature issue per se.
Priya: confirm hardware variants for the three failures: eu1-gpu-07-[03,08,09] are all revision A2 MB. rest of canary are B1/B2. that's a mismatch.
Jordan: recommendation: pause rollout for A2 hardware until we test a small patched image that increases nvram write retry. rollback plan if customers impacted: run:
```
sudo /opt/firmware/rollback.sh --target=primary --force --hosts eu1-gpu-07-03,eu1-gpu-07-08,eu1-gpu-07-09
```
Jordan: that will flip these hosts back to previous BMC slot and re-apply previous NV ram. allows them to boot without PXE.
Akshay: agree pause. also let's gate by signed image verification against HSM pubkey before flashing. chunk failure might be a timing problem but let's not risk flipping secure-boot flag on other racks.
Theo: ops note: draining these 3 hosts reduces available GPU slots in eu-west by 18 GPUs (6 each). Dedicated customers on eu-west have burst capacity scheduled. estimated immediate impact: ~0.9% capacity, cost hit if we hand over to cloud burst ~$12/hr until we rebalance.
Maria: opened INC-45321 for tracking and customer comms, tagging CS. created canary branch v2.3.1-signed-varA2 for isolated testing. pausing rollout across all A2 tagged hosts now.
OncallBot: Incident INC-45321 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-45321
Akshay: quick test plan for the canary: 1) apply patched image to 2 lab A2 hosts 2) run nvram stress loop: `for i in {1..50}; do fwctl write-var && sleep 1; done` 3) reprovision 2 ephemeral VMs 4) confirm secureboot state persists. if pass -> schedule staggered roll after 2hr hold.
Priya: i'll coordinate with lab and schedule the nvram stress. grabbing 2 A2 lab units now.
Lee: add telemetry check to Console: count `nvram_write_errors` and alert if >0 for a minute during rollout. we should also surface hardware revision in rollout UI.
Jordan: capturing rollback steps in runbook and posting in #eng-oncall after we validate. we should avoid immediate rollback of the whole canary until lab confirms patch.
Maria: thanks all. pausing now, removing A2 hosts from the job. will update after lab test (~T+2h). :thumbsup:
Theo: FYI finance, this pause may trigger a 1-time cloud burst today for customer X; estimating $120 for the day if we don't rebalance. pinging billing.
Akshay: one more: can we add a pre-flash HSM verify step to the deploy pipeline? either `hsm verify --pubkey=prod` or abort. small change but prevents corrupted chunk from proceeding.
Maria: noted. filing a small PR to the deploy pipeline. will link PR in INC-45321.
OncallBot: deploy-bot: job FW-ROLL-2105 paused by Maria at 21:12 UTC.
Maria: closing loop for now. thanks team.
